About this item

  • REVOLUTIONARY SMART TOUCHSCREEN CASE – NO PHONE OR APP REQUIRED: Elevate your lifestyle with our advanced wireless earbuds featuring a built-in LED touchscreen charging case. This all-in-one control hub allows you to skip tracks, adjust volume, manage calls, and even take remote photos or locate your ear buds directly from the case. No phone or app required—it’s the ultimate "Smarter Control" for gym workouts and busy office environments, making these Bluetooth headphones faster and more convenient than traditional models
  • HI-FI STEREO SOUND & 5 EQ MODES – INSTANT TOUCH CONTROL: Engineered with powerful 13mm dynamic drivers, these wireless earbuds deliver immersive Hi-Fi sound with deep, punchy bass and crystalline highs. Customize your listening experience instantly via 5 built-in EQ modes (Bass, Rock, Pop, etc.)—all selectable directly through the smart case. With no phone or app required to change sound profiles, these Bluetooth headphones bring theater-quality audio to life, tailored to your music style at a single tap
  • PRO-GRADE ANC & ENC CLEAR CALLS – FOCUS WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS: Silence the world with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) and ENC call reduction. Whether in a loud gym or a busy office, these noise cancelling earbuds isolate your voice and block ambient noise for crystal-clear conversations. Switch between four noise-cancelling modes directly on the case screen—no phone or app required. These Noise Cancelling Headphones ensure you stay focused and productive, providing the perfect undisturbed sanctuary anytime, anywhere
  • ADVANCED BLUETOOTH 5.4 – FAST, STABLE & LOW-LATENCY: Experience an "unbreakable" connection with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology. These wireless headphones offer ultra-fast pairing and ultra-low latency within a 33ft range. Specifically optimized for high-interference areas like subways, malls, or airports, these Bluetooth headphones ensure your music and calls remain smooth and uninterrupted, delivering the high-performance reliability you expect from premium wireless earbuds
  • 48H PLAYTIME & FEATHER-LIGHT ERGONOMIC COMFORT: Designed for marathon sessions, these wireless earbuds provide up to 6 hours of playtime per charge and 48 hours total with the smart LED case. We’ve paired this massive battery with an ultra-lightweight, 0.13 oz ergonomic design for a "zero-pressure" fit. No phone or app required to monitor battery levels or manage your settings—these earbuds stay secure and comfortable all day, whether you're commuting, studying, or hitting a new PR at the gym

    About this Item

    • REVOLUTIONARY SMART TOUCHSCREEN CASE – NO PHONE OR APP REQUIRED: Elevate your lifestyle with our advanced wireless earbuds featuring a built-in LED touchscreen charging case. This all-in-one control hub allows you to skip tracks, adjust volume, manage calls, and even take remote photos or locate your ear buds directly from the case. No phone or app required—it’s the ultimate "Smarter Control" for gym workouts and busy office environments, making these Bluetooth headphones faster and more convenient than traditional models
    • HI-FI STEREO SOUND & 5 EQ MODES – INSTANT TOUCH CONTROL: Engineered with powerful 13mm dynamic drivers, these wireless earbuds deliver immersive Hi-Fi sound with deep, punchy bass and crystalline highs. Customize your listening experience instantly via 5 built-in EQ modes (Bass, Rock, Pop, etc.)—all selectable directly through the smart case. With no phone or app required to change sound profiles, these Bluetooth headphones bring theater-quality audio to life, tailored to your music style at a single tap
    • PRO-GRADE ANC & ENC CLEAR CALLS – FOCUS WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS: Silence the world with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) and ENC call reduction. Whether in a loud gym or a busy office, these noise cancelling earbuds isolate your voice and block ambient noise for crystal-clear conversations. Switch between four noise-cancelling modes directly on the case screen—no phone or app required. These Noise Cancelling Headphones ensure you stay focused and productive, providing the perfect undisturbed sanctuary anytime, anywhere
    • ADVANCED BLUETOOTH 5.4 – FAST, STABLE & LOW-LATENCY: Experience an "unbreakable" connection with the latest Bluetooth 5.4 technology.     • 48H PLAYTIME & FEATHER-LIGHT ERGONOMIC COMFORT: Designed for marathon sessions, these wireless earbuds provide up to 6 hours of playtime per charge and 48 hours total with the smart LED case.
